@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+- Changed the default model of `GoogleVertexLLMService` from `gemini-3.6-flash` to `gemini-3.8-flash`, because Vertex AI retires `gemini-3.6-flash` on 2026-11-19. The default thinking level for the new model is `low`; pass `settings=GoogleVertexLLMService.Settings(model="gemini-3.6-flash")` to keep the previous model until then.

                 .. deprecated:: 0.0.105
